standard_prerequisites.name: Universal injectivity of a homothety in the local case
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter flat.tex, label lemma-universally-injective-local (invoked at proof line 1987)
standard_prerequisites.use: Applied to each $s \in \Sigma$, it gives universal injectivity of $s : N \to N$ over $R$.

core_obligations: Fix $s \in \Sigma$ and apply the local criterion to get universal injectivity of multiplication by $s$ on $N$ over $R$ (proof lines 1986-1988).
Conclude that the localization map $N \to \Sigma^{-1}N$ is universally injective as the directed colimit of these maps (proof lines 1989-1990).
proof_roadmap: Universal injectivity of one homothety (proof lines 1986-1988).
Localization as a directed colimit (proof lines 1989-1990).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts, under the sole extra hypothesis that $N$ is projective over $R$, that every homothety in the multiplicative set and the localization map itself are universally injective over $R$ (statement lines 1975-1983, tag 05FR-adjacent). The proof applies the local criterion for one homothety and then passes to the directed colimit defining the localization. The passage to the colimit is the substance, so the claim is H2.
